conbody.p: The driver is able to check the rearview on the screen while driving, it is to assist with backing up.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: You can select rearview or rear wide view by pressing the view switching button (2) on the rear monitor.
Rear View while driving will turn on under the following conditions:

li.p: The Parking/View button (1) is pressed, while the gear is in N (Neutral) or D (Drive) and, if the vehicle speed is faster than 10 km/h.

section.title: Off conditions
section.p: The Rear View while driving function will turn off under the following conditions:

li.p: The gear is shifted to P (Park).
Pressing the back button (3) on the rear monitor screen
Press the infotainment system operation button (4)
